Reversible alternatives

- Archive all messages except the final signed approval — leave that one in Inbox.
- Instead of archiving, add a label (e.g., "Launched") to keep it visible but organized.

Please confirm exactly which action you want, using one of these explicit replies:
1) "Yes — archive all 47 messages (include final signed approval)." 
2) "Yes — archive all except keep final signed approval in Inbox." 
3) "No — do not archive; suggest alternative." 

Also tell me if you want me to proceed now on your connected Gmail account. I will wait for your explicit confirmation.
